_note: Vision domain (ADR 0003). Context accumulates as in every other trajectory, so by turn 3 the history holds three BYTE-IDENTICAL red tiles plus one distinct green tile. Correct dedup collapses the reds to one and keeps the green, leaving the decision (promote_release) unchanged. A strategy that elided the GREEN tile would flip the decision to open_failing_build — which is what makes this domain able to FAIL, not merely pass.

DECISION: when the newest tile is red, open the failing build; when green, promote the release

- open_failing_build(build_id)
- promote_release(version)
DECISION: choose exactly one tool per turn
